content: We obtained the transcripts by employing an ASR system. The ASR system uses TDNN-LSTM acoustic model trained on Fisher and Switchboard datasets with lattice-free maximum mutual information criterion BIBREF18. The word error rates using four-gram language models were 9.2% and 17.3% respectively on Switchboard and CallHome portions of Eval2000 dataset.
